description: This file implements platform-dependent and utility functions related to cryptographic operations in C, specifically providing an interface to create a crypto object for the ANSC (Advanced Networking Service Container) system. It primarily contains a function to instantiate the crypto object.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE AnscCreateCryptoPubSSLeay(ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext)
methods.description: Creates a new crypto object for the ANSC system using the underlying implementation 'AnscCryptoPubSSLeayCreate'.
